create_DTU_dataset: create a DTU dataset instance with custom num_seq, num_frames, and ROOT path for many-view stereo training
load_cam_mvsnet: load camera intrinsics and extrinsics from an MVSNET camera txt file and return numpy arrays
sample_pairs: sample image pairs from a pair.txt file for a given sequence id and return formatted jpg filenames
get_views: get views for a given index including rgb image, depthmap, camera pose, and intrinsics from DTU scene data
load_all_scenes: load all DTU scenes from a base directory or filter by test_id list for dataset initialization
